name: vibebuddy_get_session
description: Read one session's local transcript by native key or reference, straight from the agent's own file; sequence positions are stable for its source revision.

name: vibebuddy_live_status
description: Read live sessions grouped by checkout; an optional collaboration hint, not a lock.

name: vibebuddy_handoff_facts
title: Handoff facts
description: Read the recorded facts for one session before writing a handoff: rounds ended, the checkout's git HEAD and dirty files now, files edited, commands run with exit codes, and what the observation path could not see. Pass your own session key; the tool never picks a session for you and never generates text.

key.description: Session key <agent>:<native id> (claude-code, codex, cursor, grok-build) or a vibebuddy://session/ reference; your own session's id.

commands.description: How many of the most recent commands to list (default 20, at most 50).

cwd.description: Absolute checkout path to probe with git; otherwise derived from the files the session edited.
